source_caption:
📺 iCarly (2007–2012)

iCarly follows Carly Shay, a teenager living in Seattle who unexpectedly becomes an internet sensation after creating a hilarious web show with her best friends, Sam Puckett and Freddie Benson. What begins as a fun project quickly turns into a popular online series filled with ridiculous challenges, funny sketches, unusual guests, and unpredictable adventures. As their show gains attention, Carly and her friends must balance internet fame with school, friendships, relationships, and everyday teenage problems. Meanwhile, Carly’s eccentric older brother, Spencer, adds even more chaos with his bizarre inventions and hilarious personality. Combining unforgettable comedy, relatable teenage experiences, and entertaining adventures, the series explores friendship, creativity, growing up, and the excitement of becoming an internet star.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Teen Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~23 minutes per episode • 6 seasons • 97 episodes

🎥 Creator: Dan Schneider

🏆 Recognition: Starring Miranda Cosgrove, Jennette McCurdy, Nathan Kress, and Jerry Trainor, the series became one of Nickelodeon’s most successful sitcoms, winning multiple Kids’ Choice Awards and inspiring a revival in 2021.

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ • Netflix (select regions) • Amazon Prime Video • Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: iCarly is an American comedy television series and a revival of the 2007–2012 Nickelodeon teen sitcom of the same title. The series stars Miranda Cosgrove, Jerry Trainor, Nathan Kress (all reprising their roles from the original series), Laci Mosley, and Jaidyn Triplett. It premiered on Paramount+ on June 17, 2021, to positive reviews. The second season premiered on April 8, 2022, while the third season premiered on June 1, 2023. In October 2023, the series was cancelled after three seasons.
